_comment: Editable rules mapping Nelnet document titles to filename summaries. Nelnet names a billing statement by its date, '09/27/2026 Statement', and the year-end form on Tax Info is filed as '1098-E Tax Year 2025'. Checked in order: tax, then insurance (unused), then statement. Letters and notices from the inbox classify as Other Document, are in scope by default, and are named by their own subject.
